description: APIs Netlify Edge Functions block on top of the Deno CLI, applied by the netlify-edge target. None are documented: Netlify says edge functions run in a Deno runtime that supports Node.js built-in modules, and its limits page lists size, memory and CPU time limits but no blocked APIs. The Deno version Netlify runs is not documented either; the version recorded is the minimum (^2.4.2) that @netlify/edge-bundler 16.1.1 requires. `docs` holds hashes of the Netlify docs sections this data rests on (the API page's runtime environment and supported web APIs, and the limits page), and `bundler` the release and Deno range it was read from; the weekly check compares both.
